greeting: Ahoy there! Captain Cirrus, at your service! Weather scout extraordinaire!
Beautiful day for ballooning! Or walking. Both good!
Back again? Come for another weather report?
The sky's my office! The clouds are my... coworkers?
Welcome to High-Wind Platform! Best view in Tide!
I read the weather so you don't have to! Very thoughtful of me!
New face! Want to know if it'll rain? I can tell you! It's my JOB!
Balloon's ready! Weather's clear! Life is GOOD!
dialog.weather_report: Today's forecast: Partly cloudy! Chance of fish! ...The seagulls drop things. Watch your head.
dialog.ballooning_stories: Once, I flew TOO high. Hit a flock of geese. Lesson learned: Geese don't respect airspace.
dialog.weather_control_quest_hook: My weather instruments are acting weird! Need parts from Chrono - time-synced gauges, very fancy. Without them, I'm just... guessing. Can you help?
dialog.weather_control_quest_active: The Chrono parts should fix my calibration. Weather prediction is all about PRECISION!
dialog.weather_control_quest_complete: The parts work! Perfect synchronization! I can predict weather a WHOLE HOUR in advance now! Here - take this barometer. Tells you if it's raining. Very useful!
dialog.cloud_watching: See that cloud? Looks like a rabbit. That one? Definitely a ship. That angry gray one? Rain. Definitely rain.
dialog.altitude_records: Personal best: 5,000 feet! Could see three zones! Frost looked COLD. Ember looked HOT. Obvious but impressive!
rumor: The winds are changing. Something BIG is coming. Storm season approaches!
Aeronauts in Aetherreach fly HIGHER. Not better. Just higher. Show-offs.
Frost has weird weather. Snow that falls UP sometimes.
Mire's fog isn't natural. Something creates it. Something... old.
farewell: Keep your feet dry and your eyes on the sky!
Happy trails! Or happy sails! Whichever you're doing!
Come back for tomorrow's forecast! Spoiler: probably more of the same!
Safe travels! Watch out for low-flying seagulls!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning ascent! Best time for wind patterns!
dialog.time_night: Night moored! Storm watch! Someone has to!

party_reactions.kade: You're way too cheerful for someone who works at this height.
party_reactions.twist: You FLY?! In a BALLOON?! Can I come?!
party_reactions.korr: Reading the weather is valuable. Many lives depend on it.
party_reactions.renna: Do you use magical aids? Or purely instruments?
party_reactions.suresh: Those who watch the sky learn patience. You have learned joy.
party_reactions.sova: I could shoot things from up there. Good vantage point.
party_reactions.grit: Weather killed more soldiers than enemies. Good info saves lives.
party_reactions.senna: High ground. Good for watching. Good for hiding.
party_reactions.callum: Is it scary up there? It looks scary...

relationship_dialog.stranger: Hello! First time on the platform? Watch your step!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You're back! How's the weather treating you?
relationship_dialog.friend: My friend! Come for another forecast?
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You! My favorite ground-dweller! Here - I'll give you the SECRET forecast. Don't tell anyone!

mini_quest.title: Weather Control
mini_quest.description: Retrieve time-synced gauges from Chrono for Captain Cirrus

stages.hook: My weather instruments need parts from Chrono - time-synced gauges. Without them, I'm just... guessing. Can you help?
stages.active: The Chrono parts should calibrate my instruments. Precision matters in weather!
stages.complete: Perfect synchronization! I can predict weather a WHOLE HOUR ahead now! Here - take this barometer!
